answers: lens-correctness-design finding 1: wrong — already addressed. Gap 11 in the architectural decision requires that in both dispatch-unit arms (cycle:* and stage:*), immediately after clearing `skip_until_stage` when the from-stage target is found, `resume_mode` is also set to false: `[[ -n "$skip_until_stage" ]] && { skip_until_stage=""; resume_mode=false; }`. This means after the targeted cycle clears `skip_until_stage` in the cycle:* arm, `resume_mode` becomes false before the stage:* arm processes any subsequent leaf stage — so the resume skip guard (`$resume_mode && [[ -z "$skip_until_stage" ]]`) is false for all stages after `<s>`. DSFSTG-3[code] pins this observable behavior with a 3-unit fixture [intake, cyc, verify] where verify is marked complete; the test fails on old code (verify skipped) and passes after the Gap 11 fix.

design finding 1: done — Fixed DSFSTG-3's Given: changed "the runner is invoked with both auto-resume active and --from-stage <s>" to "the runner is invoked with explicit --resume and --from-stage <s>". Since DSFSTG-4 places the validation guard before the auto-resume check, any invocation with auto-resume conditions met, --from-stage given, and no explicit --resume hits that guard and exits 1 before the dispatch loop — so the DSFSTG-3 scenario (reaching the dispatch loop) requires explicit --resume in the invocation. Also updated the corresponding step text for the DSFSTG-3 test sub-case in from-stage-rehydrate-test.sh.
